---
# No `title:` here on purpose — we want a custom hero instead of the default
# page title block. `pagetitle` only sets the browser tab text.
pagetitle: "BioM2 Lab — Home"
# Pinned on purpose: with no `image:` here Quarto uses the FIRST image in the page
# body for the link preview, which is the hero logo -- and it is an SVG, which the
# social platforms do not render. Keep this pointing at the card.
image: /images/og/biom2-card.jpg
page-layout: full
toc: false
# Show the most recent news posts below the hero.
# Deliberately a compact `table` listing of date + headline only: no images and
# no description here — the picture and the full story belong on the post page,
# which the headline links to. (`news.qmd` keeps the richer `default` layout.)
listing:
  - id: latest-news
    contents: news          # the news/ folder of posts
    type: table
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 6
    date-format: "MMM D, YYYY"
    fields: [date, title]
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
---

::: {.hero-anim}
:::

::: {.hero-banner}

     one would make Quarto render this as a figure and print the text as a
     visible caption; `fig-alt` carries it for screen readers instead. -->
